description: This script schedules device reboot times via cron, based on maintenance windows and device-specific parameters. It manages reboot flags, calculates random reboot times within specified windows, and updates cron jobs accordingly.

methods.name: calcRebootExecTime
methods.description: Calculates a random reboot time within maintenance window, adjusting for device time offset.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules a reboot cron job at the calculated time.
